case.name: Playing For Mora
case.description: Beidou suggests putting some Mora (money) on the line, to make the game more interesting.

case.name: Comfort Food
case.description: Having just stripped, Beidou asks her fellow players about their favoured comfort food, looking to get suggestions for her chef friend.

case.name: Drinks All Around
case.description: Whether she wins or loses, Beidou offers to buy drinks for everyone else. All these lines use the marker "BeidouBuysDrinks".

case.name: Cash Money
case.description: Beidou asks wealthy opponents about how they spend their money

case.name: Genius Invokation TCG
case.description: If she's at a table with only other Genshin Impact characters, after Beidou is finished, she suggests a game of Genius Invokation.

case.name: Crux Invitation
case.description: Beidou suggests that a fighter or medic character could find work with her Crux Fleet if they're ever looking for it. Characters who are also criminals receive an altered version of this line.

case.name: Musician Instruments
case.description: Beidou asks what instrument a musician opponent plays.

case.name: Singer Style
case.description: Beidou asks what a singer opponent's specialty is.

case.name: Business Opportunity
case.description: Beidou suggests a wealthy or royal opponent might want to hire her fleet to transport something.

notes.note: Beidou delivered many of the festival's fireworks from Inazuma, even during Sakoku lockdown

This is a reference to the "The Golden Apple Vacation Returns" event. Beidou is close friends with Xinyan and Kazuha, who both got to experience some of Fischl's memories and know about her being Amy during that event. I don't think Xinyan or Kazuha would have told anyone, Beidou included, about that part of the experience, only that they saw the Immernachtreich, but this could be a good opportunity to play on Fischl's insecurity if she thinks either of them might have revealed her true nature to Beidou.

Don't know how much you've read into character lore, but Hu Tao has an entry in her bio about Beidou, which reads "Beidou is well-known in Liyue. She doesn't know me, but that's cool, me just knowing about her is enough. Aw man... I really do wanna make friends with her." I'm just extrapolating from there at the moment, but we can talk about details for future interactions

The nation of Fontaine has developed cameras in Teyvat, and though they're reasonably uncommon, Beidou is passingly familiar with them, not least of all beause one of the endings to her hangout event has her having her photo taken by the player character. The idea of a modern digital camera or a video camera is still a long way off, but she's familiar with instant polaroids
Beidou grew up on the streets, but has become one of the most well-known individuals in all of Liyue, so she has thoughts on the distribution of wealth
Inspired by Yunjin and her operas, Xinyan and her rock 'n roll
Inspired by Xinyan and her rock 'n roll

Beidou and Hu Tao have now (probably?) met, and Beidou is at least aware of Tao now - they worked together using the 2025 Lantern Rite, "Springtime Charms" to resolve an issue with the border between life and death. They didn't necessarily meet personally - Beidou was tasked with guarding The Gate of Fright, but the plan was Hu Tao's, coordinated by Ningguang
Beidou would formally be referred to as "Captain Beidou". She doesn't have a surname, only her given name
The comment about Yinxing is entirely my own extrapolation. Yinxing is just one of the few members of the Crux crew who wears glasses
Don't think these two have interacted on-screen, but pretty sure they know each other, at least by reputation and/or mutual acquaintances

Yae Miko would absolutely know Beidou by reputation, seeing as she personally defied the Sakoku decree to ferry goods and people in and out of Inazuma during the lockdown (most notably Kazuha), as well as fighting on the side of the Watatsumi resistance against Kujou Sara and the Tenryou Commission. She might also have heard of the feats she performed outside of Inazuma, but those would be the most pertinent ones to Yae Miko herself
